name: TeleMinute
tagline: A single personal bot with commands, keyword replies, and a basic broadcast is a solid weekend build on Telegram's friendly Bot API. What you are really buying is the hosted no-code layer: a dashboard a non-technical shop owner edits from a phone, scheduled broadcasts, lead-capture forms, analytics, and native iOS/Android apps. If you can run code you can replace your own subscription, but you cannot hand the DIY version to a client who cannot.
